usageNote: take over就是'接手、接管'，数字255在这里超级具体，多用于新闻报道，听起来很正式！

examples.en: The new airline will take over 255 flights previously operated by the bankrupt carrier.
examples.zh: 这家新航空公司将接管那家破产航空公司此前运营的255个航班。

examples.en: Ground staff were ready to take over 255 flights during the pilot strike.
examples.zh: 在飞行员罢工期间，地勤人员准备好接管255个航班。
